evidence: Matches the Tests label and adds new benchmarks under src/bench/bip352.cpp and src/bench/CMakeLists.txt, which are explicitly covered by the category.
rationale: Adds microbenchmarks to evaluate overhead and guard against performance regressions in BIP-352 key extraction. As noted in the description, input parsing has undergone recent changes (#36338, #36417) and the worst-case malleated P2PKH input exhibits a ~23x slowdown, making regression tracking useful but deferrable.
